fields.label: Allow Marketing templates
fields.description: For now. Reps may send an approved Marketing template from the inbox or a Lead, Contact or Customer, with the same consent as a Utility one. A STOP, STOP PROMO or a marketing No still blocks it. Marketing messages cost much more than Utility ones. Automatic notifications stay Utility only.

fields.label: Send notifications
fields.description: The master switch. While it is off, no rule sends anything, even one set to Automatic. Manual approvals still work only when this is on.

fields.label: Most automatic messages per hour
fields.description: A brake: when the limit is reached the rest wait for the next hour. 0 means no limit.

fields.label: Name shown for 'Sender name' values
fields.description: An automatic message has no person behind it; this text fills any template value set to 'Sender name'.

fields.label: Only send to these phone numbers
fields.description: One per line. When this is filled, nobody else ever receives a notification (they are logged as skipped). Leave it empty for normal running. Use it for a first trial.

fields.label: Teams run the agent lists and roles
fields.description: Turned on by the Apply button on a Team after the Setup check is clean. From then on the people of each Number and their Waba roles follow the teams.

fields.label: Privacy: sensitive details in outgoing messages
fields.description: Agents cannot send Aadhaar, PAN, card, bank account, UPI or one-time-code details. A Team Lead or admin may send one anyway with a reason; every attempt is logged (Waba Privacy Log). The check is ON unless you switch it off here.

fields.label: Switch the privacy check off
fields.description: Leave this unticked for normal running.

fields.label: Do not check for Aadhaar numbers
Do not check for card numbers
Do not check for bank account numbers
Do not check for UPI IDs
Do not check for one-time codes and PINs
Allowed identifiers
fields.description: The company's own bank account numbers, UPI IDs and PAN, one per line. These always pass; anything else sensitive is still blocked.

fields.label: Campaign audience rule
fields.options:
Everyone
General consent Yes
Marketing consent Yes
fields.description: Who may go into a campaign Set. Everyone (for now): anyone with a usable number. Someone who replied STOP, who said no, or whose record says do-not-contact is always left out, whatever you choose here.

fields.label: Campaigns need approval
fields.description: Off: a Campaign Manager sends directly. On: a Waba Admin must approve (once for a whole recurring series).

fields.label: Pause after this many failures in a row
Daily new-chat allowance kept for notifications and reps (%)
A reply counts for the campaign for (days)
Campaign cost estimate
fields.description: Rupees per message before GST. The starting values are reported by vendors, not by Meta: check Meta's India rate card and correct them.

fields.label: Assign new chats automatically
fields.description: On: a new chat is given to an available agent by the number's rules. Off: a new chat waits in the Unassigned list; the Team Leads of the number are alerted and a Team Lead assigns it with Transfer. Chats already with an agent are not touched; this also stops the waiting-chat hand-out.

fields.label: Move a chat to the next available agent when its agent is Away
fields.description: Off (paused): a chat stays with its agent even while they are Away, and waiting chats are not handed out automatically; a Team Lead assigns them. New chats from new customers are still given to available agents by the number's rules. On: an Away agent's chats move to the next available agent, and waiting chats go to whoever becomes free.

fields.label: Bots are switched on
fields.description: The master switch. While it is off no bot answers anyone, whatever the individual bots say. A bot also respects the test phone list above: when it is filled, bots answer only those numbers.

fields.label: Bot builder: preview blocks
fields.description: Off for now. When it is on, the bot builder offers the preview blocks (Status lookup, Send document, Link button), the silent-customer timeout, per-block numbers and the extra starter bots. While it is off none of them can be used or published, and a bot that already uses them hands the chat to a person instead of running.

fields.label: Phone inbox (Call Tracker app)
fields.description: Off for now. When it is on, a phone signed in to the Call Tracker app can use the team inbox: the same chats, replies and rules as the desktop inbox, for people who hold a Waba role. While it is off the phone cannot call any inbox method.
